method.movement: Natural inputs after loading frame 780; no RAM writes. x is 16.16 screen position + camera; feet uses the physical anchor, not the animation offset.
method.guns: Isolated stationary firing experiment; only selected weapon ID is set in BW-RAM $1F84. Read projectiles from $AC0, stride $20. Modified SA-1 ROM, not a clean US reference.
method.maps: Base ROM map compared with running VRAM. Runtime destruction changes some cells; mismatches are preserved, not discarded. Collision is checked against the actual runtime tile entry.
